shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'ajv|ValidateFunction' package-lock.json node_modules/ajv/package.json node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80
sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts
node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"
rg -n \"registry.acceptance|re-lint|CHANGELOG|specs/hal-engine\" .eslint* specs src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | head -100
sed -n '1,220p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md; sed -n '1,220p' ../round-brief.md; sed -n '1,180p' tsconfig.json; sed -n '1,220p' .eslintrc* eslint.config.* 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validated by\" src specs adrs | head -40
sed -n '1,190p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv @types/ajv --depth=2 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts
rg -n 'interface ValidateFunction|type ValidateFunction' node_modules/@types node_modules/ajv 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"declare module ['\\\"]ajv|from ['\\\"]ajv\" src *.d.ts **/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50
rg -n 'ajv' node_modules/@types 2>/dev/null | head -30
ls -la node_modules/@types/ajv 2>/dev/null || true
cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,25p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t 'compiles a static schema once across ten executions'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t 'names the full path for a nested required property rejection'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 3 'inputSchema|defensive|cast|missing|registry|tool result|tool-result|schema' README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md | head -220
sed -n '1,140p' .specify/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t 'names the full path for a nested required property rejection'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,280p'
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo NO_REANCHOR; fi
sed -n '1,80p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,80p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' example/weather-tool.ts
sed -n '1,140p' adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts example/weather-tool.ts adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t 'names the full path for a nested required property rejection'
git diff --check"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md example/weather-tool.ts package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(tools): preserve validation paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch
git log -1 --oneline'
